prompts.name: kjp_cover_a
prompts.prompt: A huge dark studio wall made of hundreds of small glowing video thumbnail screens in a grid, like a video channel page. In the moment captured, most of the screens are switching off one after another, turning black and shattering into flying pixel fragments, only a few still glow. In front of the wall, a heavyset man in a dark suit seen only from behind as a silhouette, one hand raised holding a fan of playing cards like a magician, frozen. Cold blue screen light versus warm red warning light. Mood: shock, 'everything is disappearing'. Leave the bottom 40% of the frame dark and simple for text.
